Our Process

STEP 01

FIRST CONTACT

Reach out to us via telephone or email.

We promptly respond to your inquiry to schedule an initial consultation.

The first step is about understanding your basic legal needs & setting up a meeting (either in-person or video call).

STEP 02

INITIAL CONSULTATION

Meet with our experienced solicitors for a detailed consultation. Here, we discuss:

– The specifics of your case;

– Answer your questions; and

– Outline potential legal strategies.

This meeting can be in-person or virtual, depending on your preference.

STEP 03

CASE EVALUATION

Our team evaluates your situation to determine the best course of action.

Whether it’s a personal matter or a business-related issue, we develop a step-by-step plan tailored to your specific legal needs.

STEP 04

TRANSPARENT FEE STRUCTURE

We provide a clear & honest breakdown of our fee structure.

Understanding the cost of legal services is an important factor.

We ensure you have all the information needed to make informed decisions (without any hidden surprises).

STEP 05

ONGOING COMMUNICATION

Throughout your case, we maintain regular communication.

You’ll receive updates about the progress & developments of your case.

Our experienced team will keep you informed & involved at every stage.

STEP 06

RESOLUTION & FOLLOW-UP

At Nooney & Dowdall LLP, our team work towards a resolution of your case.

Whether it’s a settlement, negotiation, or trial, our solicitors aim for the best outcome.

After the case concludes, we’re available for any follow-up questions or additional legal guidance.

FAQs

What types of legal services does your practice offer?

We offer expertise to both private & commercial clients:

Private Client Services:

Probate

– Wills & deceased estates administration

– Wills & deceased estate disputes

– New wills & estate planning

Private client

– Power of Attorney

– Legal capacity & assisted decision making.

– EPAs – Enduring Power of Attorney – Decision Support Service

Property

– Conveyancing. House purchase & sale

– Site transfers and new home self build mortgages

– Agricultural land auction and private treaty sale & purchase

– Commercial property

Property Investment

– Landlord & tenant

– Property development

– Property disputes. Litigation & mediation

– Property tax – VHT, LPT, NPPR & stamp duty.

– Income tax & CGT. Gift & Inheritance tax – CAT.

– Property tax advise for non-residents

Personal Injury law

– Medical negligence

– Accident claims

– Personal Injury Assessment Board (PIAB)

– Circuit & High Court

– Road traffic

– Workplace injuries

Criminal law

– Representation & advice

– Garda Station, district, circuit and central criminal courts.

– Road traffic offences

Civil Litigation

– Employment law

– Family law

– Civil district court matters

Commercial Client Services:

– Property Law

– Licensing Law

– Company Law

– Contract Law & disputes

– Commercial law

– Criminal Law

– Civil Litigation
– Employment Law

How do I know if I need a solicitor?

If you are facing a legal issue or dispute, it’s advisable to consult with a solicitor. Legal matters can be complex. Having professional guidance ensures your rights are protected. Looking to resolve your legal problem? Contact our team today.

Can you guarantee a successful outcome in my case?

While we cannot guarantee specific outcomes, we assure you that our experienced solicitors will work to achieve the best possible result.

We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence & our track record of success in representing our clients.
